title: Language exam preparation: timed practice papers · Glossa
description: Timed practice papers for citizenship, residence and university language exams, from YKI and CILS to the Polish B1 certificate, NT2 and TOPIK, each with a full course.

card.title: Exam preparation
card.text: Every exam Glossa has practice papers for.

heading: Practice papers for the exam you need to pass.
lead: Each exam page says what the real exam asks, what Glossa's practice papers cover, and where they differ from the real thing. Every set of papers sits on top of a full course in the language, so what a paper shows you are missing has a module to learn it from.
fineprint: The courses are free. Practice papers are part of Premium, €8.99 a month or €69.99 a year.
